# Stéphane Rathgeber

> Tech Lead Symfony. PHP developer for more than 10 years and Symfony developer since its version 1.3, I had the opportunity to work with large companies (Renault, Accor, My Money Bank, AXA, Cardif, Maif). I accompanied and raised in competence, by my expertise, several tens of developers. I am able to start an application from scratch or to take over an existing one to make it evolve. I can also set up a continuous deployment system.

- Professional experience since 2008 (18 years)
- Current engagements: Fractional CTO / Symfony Developer at France Care; Symfony Developer / Tech Lead at GDB Consulting
- Core skills: PHP, HTML, REST, API, Symfony, Git
- Languages of this site: French (primary) and English
